sentences.en: This is the very video I have been looking for.
sentences.zh: 这是我一直在找的那个视频。

sentences.en: Please lend me the video when you have seen it.
sentences.zh: 你看完后能借给我那个视频吗？

sentences.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
sentences.zh: 我在那家店以便宜的价格买到了一台录像带录音机。

senses.zh: [电子] 视频；录像，录像机；电视
